item.description: FORMER Celtic skipper Jackie McNamara reckons the Hoops players were “spooked” by Wilfried Nancy’s team formation changes in the 2-1 loss to Hearts at Parkhead at the weekend. item.title: FAREWELL, DIXIE: CELTIC GOAL HERO PASSES AWAY, AGED 79
item.description: FORMER Celtic goal hero Dixie Deans has passed away at the age of 79. The Hoops’ legendary striker scored 124 goals in 184 appearances for the club in his five-year spell after being signed by Jock Stein from Motherwell in October 1971.
